AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  AUGUST 15, 2017

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  August 15, 2017
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present: Chang, Lazzaro, Criley & Walker
Absent: Thomas
Also Present: Deputy City Manager/Building & Planning Director Repp-Loadsman, City
Planner Corpuz, Assistant City Attorney Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC - Jeff Calvagna discussed concerns regarding the
construction of the Crown Castle wireless facilities compared to the mock ups installed. Don
Briggs discussed the poor workmanship of the construction of the Crown Castle facility at Granvia
Altamira and Cataluna Place and voiced concerns from an aesthetic standpoint.

CONSENT CALENDAR - 1

1.  Planning Commission Resolution No. 2017-0881; Confirming the Planning Commission’s
  denial of WT-136-15; Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for a new facility
  & equipment within the City right-of-way at Dolores Plaza across from 1800 Via
  Estudillo.

  Applicant:  Crown Castle NG West LLC
  300 Spectrum Center Dr., #1200
  Irvine, CA 92618

Action: Commissioner Walker moved and Commissioner Lazzaro seconded to approve (3-0
in favor, Criley recused, Thomas absent) Planning Commission Resolution No. 2017-0881.

Planning Commission  1  Director  SR-L
Action Minutes
August 15, 2017
 OLD BUSINESS

2.  NC-1599/G-1601/M-1205-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 720 Via Del Monte.
  Lot 22, Block 1537, Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Cauthen Design Inc.
  25332 Narbonne Ave., #100
  Lomita, CA 90717
  Owner:  Mike & Mimi Watson

Speakers: Ben Cauthen, Mike Watson
Action: Commissioner Walker moved and Commissioner Criley seconded to approve the
applications (3-0 in favor, Lazzaro recused, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the
following additional conditions: 1) During the plan check process, staff shall confirm that the
storage and mechanical room areas at the rear of the garage cannot be easily converted to
habitable space by requiring the finished floor area to be raised so that the ceiling height is
less than 7 ft., by requiring equipment be placed in the room, or by other similar methods
deemed appropriate by the Director; 2) A licensed survey of the floor area shall be completed
and submitted to the City to verify compliance with the approved floor area for the subject
lot; and 3) The new driveway approach shall be constructed per City standards.

3.  NC-1601/G-1603/M-1212/M-1213-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility,
  Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 701
  Mexico Place. Lot 3, Block 1430, Tract 6886. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant
  to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Tomaro Architecture
  2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd., #100
  Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner:  Joseph & Annakutty Thomas

Speakers: Louie Tomaro, Sal Danna, Cynthia Underberger, Steven Underberger, Janine Nendick
Continued to the September 19, 2017 Planning Commission meeting.

Planning Commission  2  Director  SR-L
Action Minutes
August 15, 2017
 NEW BUSINESS

4.  NC-1594/G-1597/M-1216-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 4429 Via Pinzon.
  Lot 30 & a portion of Lot 29, Block 6334, Tract 7143. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Art Ashai
  2173 Lomita Blvd. #201
  Lomita, CA 90717
  Owner:  Anjum Qazi & Asif Ghori
  22904 Samuel St.
  Torrance, CA 90505

Speaker: Art Ashai
Action: Commissioner Walker moved and Commissioner Lazzaro seconded to approve the
applications (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following
additional conditions: 1) The existing non-standard driveway approach shall be removed and
replaced with a new driveway approach constructed per City standards; 2) Prior to approval
of the walkway location, existing parkway trees shall be accurately plotted in order to ensure
that tree removal will not be necessary with construction of new walkway; 3) All non-
standard encroachments within the City right-of-way, which include walls, stairs and brick
walkway, shall be removed; and 4) The existing curb is damaged and broken or non-existent
and shall be replaced across the property frontage per City Standards, from property line to
property line.

5.  NC-1603-17; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for additions &
  remodeling to the single family residence located at 2825 Via Neve. Lot 16, Block 2235,
  Tract 7144. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code
  Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Evan Braun Design Inc.
  212 San Vicente #13
  Santa Monica, CA 90402
  Owner:  Jennifer & James Alvarez

Speakers: Kirk Erskine, Michael Bruce, Jorge Mendez
Continued to the September 19, 2017 Planning Commission meeting.

Planning Commission  3  Director  SR-L

 6.  NC-1605/G-1605/M-1215-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 4224 Via
  Valmonte. Lot 14, Block 6322, Tract 7143. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  John Heisler
  P.O. Box 1587
  Los Angeles, CA 90078
  Owner:  Victor Li

Speaker: John Heisler
Action: Commissioner Walker moved and Commissioner Lazzaro seconded to approve the
applications (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following
additional conditions: 1) The existing house shall be modified to comply with the minimum
required side yard setback, unless approval from the Palos Verdes Homes Association is
obtained for a modified setback; 2) The new driveway approach shall be constructed per City
Standards; 3) The non-standard encroachments within the City right-of-way consisting of
walls, stairs and brick walkway shall be removed; and 4) The existing curb is damaged and
broken and shall be replaced across the property frontage per City Standards.
